method: Every tick of actual production V4 stepGame at 60Hz for30s, stationary Sandfalcon opening; scanned-cover participant states asserted identical on every tick. Actual PzIII GLB every vertex +112 animated tread instances +render and ballistic muzzle points, live yaw/pitch/wheels, recoil endpoints0/.07. Source main camera42deg source offsets and 60Hz target smoothing; settled simulation pose per sample, no browser RAF interpolation claim. All landscape views use exact aspect-scaled common projection. Boxes expanded4px before comparisons.
limitations: CPU geometry not browser CSS/GPU/pixel visibility or comfort acceptance.
Stationary opening only; player movement and aim change camera and require additional device testing.
Axis-aligned mesh envelope intersection is conservative: overlapping boxes need not mean visible pixel overlap.
Every simulation tick, not every possible render-time interpolation; recoil endpoint union bounds intermediate linear recoil at a fixed tick.
1280 desktop governor width220 is a conservative source budget, not measured CSS; touch controls absent for fine pointer, coarse-pointer desktop not included.
Whole top strip treated occupied conservatively even if rendered as separated chips.
Mac samples are noncontemporaneous single-body references, not substituted for trajectory bounds.
